tma_strategy: perf has no metric definitions for this CPU model, but the kernel exports the hardware top-down events (slots + topdown-*). Level-1 and Level-2 fractions are computed by cpuinf/metrics.py as event/slots.

events.scope: per-thread (core PMU, counts only the measured thread on its core)
events.description: Core clock cycles while the thread was running (unhalted).
events.interpretation: Time in core clocks. At a fixed 2.1 GHz, cycles / 2.1e9 = seconds on CPU.

events.scope: per-thread (core PMU, counts only the measured thread on its core)
events.description: Retired (architecturally completed) instructions.
events.interpretation: Work done in instructions. IPC = instructions / cycles.

events.scope: per-thread (core PMU, counts only the measured thread on its core)
events.description: Cycles at the fixed reference (TSC) rate while unhalted.
events.interpretation: cycles / ref_cycles x TSC frequency = actual average core frequency.

events.scope: per-thread (core PMU, counts only the measured thread on its core)
events.description: Retired branch instructions.
events.interpretation: Control-flow density; high in scalar/Python code.

events.scope: per-thread (core PMU, counts only the measured thread on its core)
events.description: Retired mispredicted branches.
events.interpretation: Each costs roughly 15-20 cycles of wasted pipeline work; check Bad Speculation.

events.scope: per-thread (core PMU, counts only the measured thread on its core)
events.description: Generic 'cache references'. On Intel this maps to LONGEST_LAT_CACHE.REFERENCE (core requests that look up the LLC).
events.interpretation: Requests that missed the private L1+L2 and went to the shared L3. Not 'all cache accesses'.

events.scope: per-thread (core PMU, counts only the measured thread on its core)
events.description: Generic 'cache misses'. On Intel: LONGEST_LAT_CACHE.MISS (L3 misses, incl. prefetches).
events.interpretation: Requests that missed L3 and were served by memory (or another socket). An LLC miss is not proof of a demand DRAM stall: prefetches are included.

events.scope: per-thread (kernel software counter)
events.description: Context switches of the measured thread.
events.interpretation: Noise indicator: should be ~0 in a timed region.

events.scope: per-thread (kernel software counter)
events.description: Migrations of the thread between CPUs.
events.interpretation: Must be 0 when pinned with taskset.

events.scope: per-thread (kernel software counter)
events.description: Page faults (minor + major).
events.interpretation: Fresh allocations being touched for the first time; costs kernel time.

events.scope: per-thread (kernel software counter)
events.description: CPU time of the thread in nanoseconds.
events.interpretation: Cross-check against wall-clock time.

events.scope: per-thread (core PMU, counts only the measured thread on its core)
events.description: Pipeline issue slots (machine width x cycles; 6 slots/cycle on Golden Cove).
events.interpretation: Denominator for every top-down fraction.

events.scope: per-thread (core PMU, counts only the measured thread on its core)
events.description: Slots that issued uops which eventually retired.
events.interpretation: Useful work. High Retiring + low IPC can still mean wasteful (e.g. scalar) code.

events.scope: per-thread (core PMU, counts only the measured thread on its core)
events.description: Slots wasted on uops that were cancelled (mispredicts, machine clears).
events.interpretation: Speculation waste.

events.scope: per-thread (core PMU, counts only the measured thread on its core)
events.description: Slots where the frontend delivered no uop while the backend could accept one.
events.interpretation: Instruction fetch/decode limits (i-cache, ITLB, decoders, DSB).

events.scope: per-thread (core PMU, counts only the measured thread on its core)
events.description: Slots where no uop issued because the backend lacked resources.
events.interpretation: Either waiting on memory (Memory Bound) or on execution units (Core Bound).

events.scope: per-thread (core PMU, counts only the measured thread on its core)
events.description: Retiring slots from instructions decoding to >= 2 uops or microcode.
events.interpretation: Level-2 split of Retiring: Heavy vs Light operations.

events.scope: per-thread (core PMU, counts only the measured thread on its core)
events.description: Bad-speculation slots due to branch mispredicts.
events.interpretation: Level-2 split of Bad Speculation: Branch Mispredict vs Machine Clears.

events.scope: per-thread (core PMU, counts only the measured thread on its core)
events.description: Frontend-bound slots due to fetch latency (i-cache/ITLB misses, resteers).
events.interpretation: Level-2 split of Frontend Bound: Fetch Latency vs Fetch Bandwidth.

events.scope: per-thread (core PMU, counts only the measured thread on its core)
events.description: Backend-bound slots attributed to the memory subsystem.
events.interpretation: Level-2 split of Backend Bound: Memory Bound vs Core Bound.

events.scope: per-thread (core PMU, counts only the measured thread on its core)
events.description: Retired scalar FP32 arithmetic instructions (FMA counts twice).
events.interpretation: 1 FLOP each.

events.scope: per-thread (core PMU, counts only the measured thread on its core)
events.description: Retired 128-bit (SSE/AVX xmm) packed FP32 instructions (FMA counts twice).
events.interpretation: 4 FLOPs each.

events.scope: per-thread (core PMU, counts only the measured thread on its core)
events.description: Retired 256-bit (AVX/AVX2 ymm) packed FP32 instructions (FMA counts twice).
events.interpretation: 8 FLOPs each.

events.scope: per-thread (core PMU, counts only the measured thread on its core)
events.description: Retired 512-bit (AVX-512 zmm) packed FP32 instructions (FMA counts twice).
events.interpretation: 16 FLOPs each.

events.scope: per-thread (core PMU, counts only the measured thread on its core)
events.description: Retired scalar FP64 arithmetic instructions.
events.interpretation: Should be ~0 in FP32 inference.

events.scope: per-thread (core PMU, counts only the measured thread on its core)
events.description: Retired 512-bit packed FP64 instructions.
events.interpretation: Should be ~0 in FP32 inference.

events.scope: per-thread (core PMU, counts only the measured thread on its core)
events.description: Cycles the AMX unit is busy.
events.interpretation: Non-zero only if a kernel uses AMX tiles (bf16/int8).

events.scope: per-thread (core PMU, counts only the measured thread on its core)
events.description: Retired load instructions.
events.interpretation: Denominator for hit/miss ratios by level.

events.scope: per-thread (core PMU, counts only the measured thread on its core)
events.description: Retired store instructions.

events.scope: per-thread (core PMU, counts only the measured thread on its core)
events.description: Retired loads whose data came from L1D.
events.interpretation: Data source attribution for *retired demand loads*.

events.scope: per-thread (core PMU, counts only the measured thread on its core)
events.description: Retired loads that missed L1D.

events.scope: per-thread (core PMU, counts only the measured thread on its core)
events.description: Retired loads that missed L1D but hit a fill buffer already fetching the line.
events.interpretation: Line was already in flight (often thanks to a prefetch or a neighbouring load).

events.scope: per-thread (core PMU, counts only the measured thread on its core)
events.description: Retired loads served by L2.

events.scope: per-thread (core PMU, counts only the measured thread on its core)
events.description: Retired loads that missed L2.

events.scope: per-thread (core PMU, counts only the measured thread on its core)
events.description: Retired loads served by L3.

events.scope: per-thread (core PMU, counts only the measured thread on its core)
events.description: Retired loads that missed L3 (served by DRAM or remote).
events.interpretation: Strongest per-thread evidence that a *demand load* went beyond the LLC.

events.scope: per-thread (core PMU, counts only the measured thread on its core)
events.description: Cache lines brought into L1D (demand + prefetch).
events.interpretation: x 64 B = bytes filled into L1D: an estimate of L2->L1 traffic.

events.scope: per-thread (core PMU, counts only the measured thread on its core)
events.description: Cache lines filled into L2 (demand + prefetch).
events.interpretation: x 64 B = bytes filled into L2: an estimate of L3/DRAM->L2 traffic.

events.scope: per-thread (core PMU, counts only the measured thread on its core)
events.description: Modified/forwarded lines evicted from L2 (write-backs toward L3).
events.interpretation: x 64 B ~ L2->L3 write-back traffic.

events.scope: per-thread (core PMU, counts only the measured thread on its core)
events.description: L2 requests that missed (demand + prefetch).

events.scope: per-thread (core PMU, counts only the measured thread on its core)
events.description: L2 hardware prefetch requests.
events.interpretation: How much of the traffic is prefetcher-driven.

events.scope: per-thread (core PMU, counts only the measured thread on its core)
events.description: Demand data reads sent beyond L2 (to the uncore).

events.scope: per-thread (core PMU, counts only the measured thread on its core)
events.description: Demand data reads that were served by DRAM (offcore response).
events.interpretation: Per-thread DRAM attribution for demand reads (prefetches excluded).

events.scope: per-thread (core PMU, counts only the measured thread on its core)
events.description: All reads to core (demand + prefetch) served by DRAM.

events.scope: per-thread (core PMU, counts only the measured thread on its core)
events.description: Completed page walks caused by loads.
events.interpretation: TLB reach problems.

events.scope: per-thread (core PMU, counts only the measured thread on its core)
events.description: Cycles with no uop executed on any port.
events.interpretation: Total execution stalls.

events.scope: per-thread (core PMU, counts only the measured thread on its core)
events.description: Execution stalls while an L1D-miss demand load is outstanding.

events.scope: per-thread (core PMU, counts only the measured thread on its core)
events.description: Execution stalls while an L2-miss demand load is outstanding.

events.scope: per-thread (core PMU, counts only the measured thread on its core)
events.description: Execution stalls while an L3-miss demand load is outstanding.
events.interpretation: Upper bound on cycles lost waiting for DRAM by demand loads.

events.scope: per-thread (core PMU, counts only the measured thread on its core)
events.description: Stall cycles where a load was outstanding (any level).

events.scope: per-thread (core PMU, counts only the measured thread on its core)
events.description: Cycles where the store buffer was full and no load was outstanding.
events.interpretation: Store-bandwidth pressure.

events.scope: per-thread (core PMU, counts only the measured thread on its core)
events.description: Cycles with at least one L1D miss outstanding.

events.scope: per-thread (core PMU, counts only the measured thread on its core)
events.description: Sum over cycles of outstanding L1D misses.
events.interpretation: pending / pending_cycles = memory-level parallelism (avg. misses in flight).

events.scope: per-thread (core PMU, counts only the measured thread on its core)
events.description: Cycles a demand request was blocked because the fill buffers were full.
events.interpretation: Too many misses in flight: per-core bandwidth limit.

events.scope: per-thread (core PMU, counts only the measured thread on its core)
events.description: Uops dispatched on port 0 (ALU, FMA/vector on 512-bit fused p0+p1).

events.scope: per-thread (core PMU, counts only the measured thread on its core)
events.description: Uops dispatched on port 1 (ALU; vector port fused with p0 for 512-bit).

events.scope: per-thread (core PMU, counts only the measured thread on its core)
events.description: Uops dispatched on ports 5 and 11 (ALU, shuffle, 2nd 512-bit FMA on server parts).

events.scope: per-thread (core PMU, counts only the measured thread on its core)
events.description: Uops dispatched on port 6 (ALU, branch).

events.scope: per-thread (core PMU, counts only the measured thread on its core)
events.description: Uops dispatched on load ports 2, 3 and 10.
events.interpretation: Up to 3 loads/cycle (2 for 512-bit).

events.scope: per-thread (core PMU, counts only the measured thread on its core)
events.description: Store-address uops (ports 7, 8).

events.scope: per-thread (core PMU, counts only the measured thread on its core)
events.description: Store-data uops (ports 4, 9).

events.scope: per-thread (core PMU, counts only the measured thread on its core)
events.description: Uops executed by the thread.

events.scope: per-thread (core PMU, counts only the measured thread on its core)
events.description: Uops issued by the RAT to the RS.

events.scope: per-thread (core PMU, counts only the measured thread on its core)
events.description: Cycles with exactly 1 uop executed across all ports (non-stall).
events.interpretation: Low execution parallelism.

events.scope: per-thread (core PMU, counts only the measured thread on its core)
events.description: Cycles with exactly 2 uops executed.

events.scope: per-thread (core PMU, counts only the measured thread on its core)
events.description: Uops delivered from the decoded-uop cache (DSB).

events.scope: per-thread (core PMU, counts only the measured thread on its core)
events.description: Uops delivered from legacy decoders (MITE).

events.scope: per-thread (core PMU, counts only the measured thread on its core)
events.description: Uops delivered by the microcode sequencer.

events.scope: per-thread (core PMU, counts only the measured thread on its core)
events.description: Uops delivered by the loop stream detector.

events.scope: per-thread (core PMU, counts only the measured thread on its core)
events.description: Cycles stalled on instruction-cache misses.

events.scope: socket-wide (uncore PMU; includes every process on the socket)
events.description: DRAM read CAS commands summed over all memory channels (perf scales to MiB).
events.interpretation: Actual bytes read from DRAM by the whole socket (64 B per CAS).

events.scope: socket-wide (uncore PMU; includes every process on the socket)
events.description: DRAM write CAS commands summed over all memory channels.
events.interpretation: Actual bytes written to DRAM by the whole socket.
